Comments: Comprehensive strategic framework: National Electronic Government Plan (NeGP) 2023-2026 and National Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2027. Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: Zamportal (single window digital platform) operational with 250+ government services integrated; ZMW 1.5 billion collected as of Dec 2022. Data Interoperability Standards published January 2024 by SMART Zambia Institute (SZI), mandatory for all MPSAs with annual compliance audits. Multiple sector systems operational (INRIS, ZIAMIS, ZIMS, ZILAS, IFMIS, HMIS). GWAN: 263 of 15,600 sites connected (Dec 2022). Partially operational.
